title: Isolate native Ollama tool-calling from OpenClaw
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$ep=Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint-v414.json';if(-not(Test-Path $ep)){throw 'OLLAMA_ENDPOINT_ARTIFACT_MISSING'};$base=(Get-Content $ep -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).baseUrl;$tags=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 10;$models=@($tags.models|ForEach-Object{$_.name});if($models.Count -eq 0){throw 'NO_OLLAMA_MODELS'};$tool=@{type='function';function=@{name='write_probe';description='Create a probe file';parameters=@{type='object';properties=@{path=@{type='string'};content=@{type='string'}};required=@('path','content')}}};$results=@();foreach($m in $models){$showBody=@{model=$m}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5;$show=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/show') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $showBody -TimeoutSec 30;$caps=@($show.capabilities);$chatBody=@{model=$m;stream=$false;messages=@(@{role='user';content='Use the write_probe tool to create C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/native-tool-probe.txt with content NATIVE_TOOL_OK. Do not answer normally; call the tool.'});tools=@($tool)}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20;$resp=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/chat') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $chatBody -TimeoutSec 180;$tc=@($resp.message.tool_calls);$txt=[string]$resp.message.content;$native=($tc.Count -gt 0);$results+=[pscustomobject]@{model=$m;capabilities=($caps -join ',');nativeToolCalls=$tc.Count;content=$txt};Write-Output ('MODEL='+$m+' CAPS='+($caps -join ',')+' NATIVE_TOOL_CALLS='+$tc.Count);if($txt){Write-Output ('CONTENT='+($txt -replace '[
]+',' '))}};$results|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content (Join-Path $root '057f-native-ollama-tool-evidence.json') -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output 'V435_057F_DIAG=PASS'
